description: Report the session state of a task you have claimed — working, waiting_input, or errored — without extending the lease. Use this to flag that you are blocked on input or hit an error: the claim stays visible as held-but-stuck instead of faking liveness. Humans and orchestrators see the state via list_tasks/get_task. Fails with 409 if you no longer hold an active claim. Hosted API only.

detail.description: Free-text detail (max 500 chars, e.g. 'needs prod API key', 'build failed: missing dep')

name: set_task_state
